description: This PHP source file defines the class TCPDFEngine within the SuiteCRM project. It extends the PDFEngine class and provides functionality to generate PDFs using the SuiteTCPDF library. The class includes methods for writing HTML content, configuring PDF options, adding CSS styles, and outputting the PDF document. It also manages the integration of default styles and header/footer content for PDFs.

classes.name: TCPDFEngine
classes.description: A class extending PDFEngine to generate PDFs using SuiteTCPDF, including methods for writing HTML, headers, footers, configuring styles, and outputting the PDF.

methods.name: writeHTML
methods.description: Writes HTML content into the PDF, adding a blank page if none exists.

methods.name: outputPDF
methods.description: Outputs the generated PDF to a file or user (download) based on parameters.

methods.name: writeHeader
methods.description: Sets HTML header content for the PDF.

methods.name: writeFooter
methods.description: Sets HTML footer content for the PDF.

methods.name: addCSS
methods.description: Adds CSS styles to the PDF content.

methods.name: getCSS
methods.description: Retrieves combined CSS styles wrapped in style tags.

methods.name: writeBlankPage
methods.description: Adds a new blank page to the PDF.

methods.name: configurePDF
methods.description: Configures PDF settings based on include config mapping file, initializing the SuiteTCPDF object.
